title: report
description: A session tells its parent or the user that the work is done or blocked. The reader must act.

summary.description: One or two short sentences, 300 characters maximum: the result first. No URL: put each URL in links. Name a decision by its question, not by its id.

done.description: The finished items: one fact for each item, 200 characters maximum, no paragraph. Name a decision by its question, not by its id.

next.description: The next steps: one step for each item, 200 characters maximum.

blockers.description: The problems that stop the work: one for each item, 200 characters maximum.
